explication: This repository is a read-only subset of .NET Framework reference-source libraries, not one application with a single runtime workflow. Its user-facing pattern is that .NET developers consult or leverage framework APIs to support their scenarios. The tree and excerpts show distinct areas including ASP.NET, async compatibility, data access, workflow, dynamic C# binding, XML serialization, and networking. The graph groups those areas without inventing calls between them; several nodes represent sampled implementation files, not a complete inventory of the framework.
